Bionic.description:
A part fitted in place of the player's own: a grade of the power cell, the legs or the
feet, the datajack or the eye.
Bionic.title: Bionic

Item.description: Something the player carries, or a stack of it.

id.description: What it is, the same for every one of its kind, e.g. "copper_wire" or "lamp". Salvage is priced by it.
id.title: Id

name.description: What the player sees, e.g. "Copper wire".
name.title: Name

weight.description: In kg, each, counted against the carry limit.
weight.title: Weight

amount.description: How many in the stack. Only material and rounds stack: rounds come whole, and material in any amount, since it comes from scrap by weight. Left out while it's 1.
amount.title: Amount

charge.description: A lamp's battery, from 0 (flat) to 1 (full). It runs down while the lamp is on, and at a plug it charges, on or off. Null for anything else.
charge.title: Charge

on.description: Whether a lamp is switched on, running its battery down. The player switches it, and it goes off by itself when it's flat. Null for anything else.
on.title: On

material.description: What material, rounds or a weapon are made of. A material's `id` is this. Left out for anything else.

rounds.description: The rounds loaded in a weapon, up to its `capacity`. Left out for anything else.
rounds.title: Rounds

capacity.description: The most rounds a weapon holds. Left out for anything else.
capacity.title: Capacity

condition.description: A weapon's wear, from 1 (new) to 0 (worn out). Left out for anything else.
condition.title: Condition

bionic.description: What a salvaged bionic refits as, grade and all, which is also its `id`. Left out for anything else.

Item.title: Item

ItemKind.description:
What it's for: `salvage` to sell, `food` to eat, the `lamp` to see by, a `part` to fit,
`material` to print with, a `weapon` to fire, `rounds` to load it with, or a salvaged `bionic`
to have refitted.
ItemKind.title: ItemKind

MapTile.description: A tile on a given map: the village or an interior, or in side view a street or a floor.
MapTile.title: MapTile

Material.description: What the printer prints with, which decides how hard its weapons and rounds hit.
Material.title: Material

description:
A body left `at` the tile it fell on, or the ground below it, with what was on it. It goes
once nothing is left on it, and a save with an emptied one loads without it.

id.description: Which corpse, as two can lie on one tile.
id.title: Id

owner.description: Whose body it was: `"player"` for the player's own.
owner.title: Owner

bionics.description: The bionics still in it, which come out as `bionic` items.
bionics.title: Bionics

title: Corpse
